_meta.note: Corrected versions of the original prompt's competition section plus everything that was missing.

UEFA.name: UEFA Champions League
UEFA.format: 36-team league phase (8 matches each, Sep-Jan). 1st-8th → Round of 16; 9th-24th → two-leg knockout play-off; 25th-36th eliminated. Round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals are TWO legs (the original prompt said one leg — wrong). Single-match final in late May/early June.

UEFA.name: UEFA Europa League
UEFA.format: 36-team league phase, same structure as the UCL. Thursday nights.

UEFA.name: UEFA Conference League
UEFA.format: 36-team league phase with 6 matches each, then knockouts.

UEFA.name: UEFA Super Cup
UEFA.format: UCL winner vs UEL winner, August, neutral venue.

UEFA.name: UEFA Youth League
UEFA.format: U19 version of the Champions League — a realistic stage for a 17-18-year-old at a big academy.

CONMEBOL.name: CONMEBOL Libertadores
CONMEBOL.format: 3 qualifying rounds → 32-team group stage (8 groups of 4, Apr-May) → two-leg knockouts → single-match final (Nov) at a neutral venue.

CONMEBOL.name: CONMEBOL Sudamericana
CONMEBOL.format: Group stage; 3rd-placed Libertadores group teams drop in; single-match final.

CONMEBOL.name: CONMEBOL Recopa
CONMEBOL.format: Libertadores winner vs Sudamericana winner, two legs, Feb/Mar.

AFC.name: AFC Champions League Elite
AFC.format: 24 clubs (12 East, 12 West). League stage of 8 matches (Sep-Feb) → East/West Round of 16 (two legs) → centralised Finals (QF, SF, final) in Saudi Arabia in April-May.

AFC.name: AFC Champions League Two
AFC.format: 32 clubs in 8 groups of 4 (Sep-Dec) → two-leg knockouts → single-match final. Main continental competition for Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese and Malaysian clubs.

AFC.name: AFC Challenge League
AFC.format: Third tier, replaced the AFC Cup from 2024-25. Lower-ranked associations.

AFC.name: ASEAN Club Championship (Shopee Cup)
AFC.format: Southeast Asian club competition revived in 2024-25.

CAF.name: CAF Champions League
CAF.format: Qualifying rounds → 16-team group stage → two-leg knockouts including a two-leg final.

CAF.name: CAF Super Cup
CAF.format: CL winner vs Confederation Cup winner.

CONCACAF.name: Leagues Cup
CONCACAF.format: All MLS and Liga MX clubs, July-August; top finishers qualify for the Champions Cup.

CONCACAF.name: Concacaf Central American Cup
CONCACAF.format: Central American clubs, Aug-Dec; top finishers → Champions Cup. Replaced the CONCACAF League.

FIFA.name: FIFA Club World Cup
FIFA.format: 32 clubs, every 4 years, group stage + knockouts. 2025 edition in the USA: Chelsea beat PSG 3-0 in the final. Next: 2029.

FIFA.name: FIFA Intercontinental Cup
FIFA.format: Annual (December). UCL winner enters the final; other continental champions play earlier rounds. 2024: Real Madrid. 2025: PSG (verify).

international.fifaWindows: September, October, November, March, June. Players must be released by clubs.

senior.name: FIFA World Cup 2026
senior.format: 48 teams, 12 groups of FOUR (the original prompt said 3 per group — wrong). Top 2 + 8 best third-placed → Round of 32. 104 matches. Final at MetLife Stadium, New Jersey.
senior.notes: Remaining places came from the UEFA play-offs and the intercontinental play-off in March 2026 (verify). Indonesia reached the AFC 4th round but were eliminated in October 2025. If the career starts in July 2025, qualifying is still in progress — the simulation can decide it.

senior.name: FIFA World Cup 2030
senior.hosts: Spain, Portugal, Morocco (+ centenary opening matches in Uruguay, Argentina, Paraguay)

senior.name: UEFA European Championship
senior.next: EURO 2028 (England, Scotland, Wales, Republic of Ireland; 24 teams)

senior.name: UEFA Nations League
senior.format: Leagues A-D, autumn; Finals in June of odd years.

senior.name: AFC Asian Cup
senior.notes: Indonesia qualified for the 2027 Asian Cup (verify).

senior.name: Africa Cup of Nations
senior.notes: Held in winter — African players miss a month of the European club season.

senior.name: ASEAN Mitsubishi Electric Cup (AFF Championship)
senior.format: Biennial, Southeast Asian senior teams; not in a FIFA window, so European clubs can refuse to release players — a big storyline for Indonesia's Europe-based players.

youth.name: FIFA U-17 World Cup
youth.format: Now ANNUAL with 48 teams, hosted in Qatar 2025-2029.

youth.name: AFC U-17 Asian Cup
youth.format: Annual from 2025 (qualifies for the U-17 World Cup).

youth.name: AFC U-23 Asian Cup
youth.format: Every 2 years; in Olympic years it decides Asia's Olympic places. 2026 edition in Saudi Arabia (January). Indonesia reached the 2024 semi-finals.

youth.name: Southeast Asian Games (SEA Games)
youth.format: Every 2 years, U-22 (+ overage). Indonesia won gold in 2023. 2025 edition in Thailand (December).

youth.name: ASEAN U-23 / U-19 / U-16 Championships
youth.format: Regional youth tournaments; Indonesia won the 2024 ASEAN U-19.

awards.name: AFC Player of the Year / AFC Youth Player of the Year / AFC Foreign Player of the Year
League awards: PFA Player of the Year, Premier League Player/Young Player of the Season, LaLiga MVP, Serie A MVP, etc.
Indonesia: Super League Best Player, Best Young Player, Top Scorer; Golden Ball at the ASEAN Championship
Club awards: Player of the Season, Young Player of the Season, Goal of the Season

September: AFC Champions League Elite & Two begin
December: Premier League plays through Christmas; most others pause late Dec
ASEAN Championship (in even years) / SEA Games (odd years)
January: Supercopa de España & Supercoppa Italiana (Saudi Arabia)
March: Ramadan often falls Feb-Apr in 2025-2027 (affects Muslim players' training and fasting)
April: ACL Elite Finals in Saudi Arabia (Apr-May)
May: Domestic cup finals (FA Cup, Copa del Rey, DFB-Pokal, Coppa Italia)
